translated_text: And Agole 13. 4. 40 My darling, Except I work and I already earn something. I don't have much, but it's enough to live on for 2 or 3 people. I was offered after a few days if, after the beginning, you do the work, I will receive more. I'm waiting now until everything is in order and you can come to my place. Vypred wants to look for Riebes, wrote we will stay here until nasihateau and the situation is clearer. Except I think I'll come to your place after 10-14 days. I want to come back right away because of my place here. I want to find a small apartment near here (more or less) near the mother. My darling, I am very happy. I want to see you as soon as possible. I'm not discouraged yet. It's a matter of 10 days. I hope to find you in good health. I found Tule and many old friends. No, I'm not happy. All my hopes for a happy life are with you. Just a few more days, my little wife and I will be together, as you are crazy about me. To start a new life, I am full of spirit and I am saying hello, dear, to my little one. For Job. Don AP AGE 1137 HERAUL Madame E. Zweigenthal at the Moneil Liginiac Corrèze by 16s 4. B on Ziegenthal tydle 17. compe (Herauld) CORY L 40 ZE
